title: Decision Lawyer Finding
description: The structured payload a single BLIND panel lawyer (trio or quartet seat) returns in the decision pattern, so the decision-arbiter can adjudicate multiple reviews without context dilution instead of parsing prose essays. This file defines the SHAPE and value domains only; the panel roles, briefings, arbiter mandate, and adjudication SEMANTICS live in the flow-decision skill + the decision-arbiter agent. Referenced co-located schemas: {"$ref": "severity.schema.json"}.

findings.description: The seat's per-claim findings — one entry per structural/skeptic/operability claim it makes about the proposal.

recommendation.description: The seat's ONE-LINE overall recommendation across all its findings — a single crisp judgment, not a prose summary.

claim.description: ONE line: the specific assertion the lawyer makes about the proposal from its lens.

evidence.description: A `file:line` (or `file:start-end`) site grounding the claim in the actual artifact, per the verify-against-the-code mandate.

verdict.description: ONE line: the lawyer's per-claim judgment in its own words — a free-form disposition, NOT a fixed enum (e.g. "sound", "drop it", "justification not shown — confirm premise Y"). The value domain is deliberately open; the seat's lens shapes the phrasing.

findings.claim: the 3-way split leaves order/mapper and order/api mutually recursive
findings.verdict: structurally unsound — the split does not decouple the two modules

findings.claim: extracting the client is a pure win with no new coupling

examples.recommendation: extract the client only; do not attempt the 3-way split until the recursion is broken
